title: Blue Roof Installations for Hurricane Ida Survivors
description: MATHEWS, LA (Sept. 23, 2021) -- The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Blue Roof Program is available for free to homeowners affected by Hurricane Ida. To date, more than 44,000 homeowners have registered in Louisiana.

transcript.text: It's amazing. It's amazing and I'm just amazed at how quickly y'all came out.
Well, I really appreciate your coming. Thank you so much. Well, thank you for having us and
welcoming us. It can be a little overwhelming with everything else going on to have this big group
well it's been a pleasure. It's been an absolute pleasure. Thank you.
There is tremendous need for a lot of assistance across Louisiana, across at least 25 parishes. One of
those needs is temporary repair for roofs. So we right now have about 50,000 requests for
the temporary roof that have been validated and those are across many different parishes. So while
we were able to get started in New Orleans, the need is far beyond that. Right now I'm standing in
